The EU AI Act and the Frontier AI Safety Commitments support multi-stakeholder GPAI evaluation portability in the following two ways:

1. The EU AI Act outlines that GPAI evaluations can be conducted by at least three distinct parties: GPAI providers, the EU AI Office, and qualified independent experts on behalf of the AI Office. This multi-party involvement facilitates a broader range of evaluations and enhances the portability of evaluation results across different stakeholders.

2. The Frontier AI Safety Commitments encourage signatories to consider results from both internal and external evaluations, including those conducted by independent third-party evaluators. This commitment to utilizing diverse evaluation results promotes the sharing and portability of evaluation findings among various stakeholders and organizations.
